annotations.title: Read a form's destination for one provider

description: Report whether one form sends its answers to a provider, and the stored configuration if it does. Credentials are never returned. Call this before changing anything so you know what is already wired up. Needs integrations:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

provider.description: Which destination: google_sheets, notion, slack, hubspot, or discord.
